items.title: Atrial Fibrillation: Updates for Patients and Families
items.summary: Dr. Rachita Navara, CEO and cofounder of Safebeat Rx, had an informative webinar on Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) management, treatment and prevention for patients and families. Her presentation aimed to empower patients and their families with knowledge about this common heart rhythm disorder. This insightful event was hosted by the American College of Cardiology Electrophysiology Council.
